people.name: Ahikam
people.line: Son of Shaphan, protected Jeremiah from death

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Shaphan
people.line: Scribe during the reign of King Josiah

translations.web: But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so that they didn’t give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
translations.bsb: Nevertheless, Ahikam son of Shaphan supported Jeremiah, so he was not handed over to the people to be put to death.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
